summary: An AskUserQuestion option with a long description stayed readable on the phones. On native Android the option was a TextButton whose row gave the label weight but not the description, so a long description squeezed the label to one character per line and overlapped it. Each option is now one selectable row at least 48 dp tall: the label, then the description under it, in a weighted column, with a checkbox (multi-select) or radio button (single choice) at the end, and the row carries the selected state and the role. The React Native option already stacked label and description; it gets a 48 pt minimum height and the same checkbox or radio role and checked state. Neither phone offers an 'Other' option.

desktop.reason: The desktop QuestionCard is a separate web component and was not reported broken; this fixes the two phone layouts only.

sharedBackendApi.reason: Layout only; the question and answer wire format is unchanged.
